LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.PointCharge.Label: Point charge
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.PointCharge.Desc: Charge in a straight line toward a hostile pawn within range. Damage is based on the lance's current durability, then the lance loses durability and the survivor is stunned. Break through walls along the path, removing up to 1550 total current wall hit points. If a wall still blocks the path after this budget is spent, stop before it and cancel the target hit.
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.LineCharge.Label: Line charge
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.LineCharge.Desc: Charge in a straight line toward a selected cell or hostile pawn, striking, stunning, and knocking away each hostile pawn passed. A mounted rider also attacks those targets. Break through walls along the path, removing up to 1550 total current wall hit points. If the remaining budget cannot destroy a wall, spend the rest on it and stop before it.

LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.LineCharge.InvalidTarget: Select a ground cell or living hostile pawn between {0} and {1} cells away.
